messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging - ingress-euc3 experiencing elevated 5xx and connection resets (alert=ingress-5xx-euc3-01). Severity: P1.

alex: I can see a sharp spike in 5xx starting ~09:14 UTC. Error distribution: 502 from proxy and ECONNRESET at upstream.

jamie: Envoy metrics show surge of downstream RSTs on euc3 ingresses. CPU and memory look fine. No deploys in last 2h per deploy-bot.

priya: network panel: several AZ peerings in euc3 reporting packet loss and retransmits. BGP sessions show intermittent flaps on a subset of spine routers per cloud provider.

oncall-sre: taking lead. Roles: jamie = ingress traces & envoy config, priya = cloud-provider/peering liaison, alex = request routing and LB health, support-lead = customer comms.

support-lead: initial impact estimate: ~18% of requests to region euc3 failing intermittently. Flagging top impacted customers: medstream, shopwise. Preparing a short customer advisory.

jamie: attempting direct curl to app backends from inside VPC: hits succeed. Curl via NLB/ingress fails with timeout or 502. So likely load balancer/edge level.

net-ops-bot: Recent changes: provider announced scheduled maintenance at 09:00 UTC for some peering equipment in euc3, currently marked as in-progress.

priya: opened live support with provider, requesting BGP adjacencies, recent config pushes, and any known reboots. Asking for packet captures on provider-facing interface.

alex: in the meantime, can we offload traffic from euc3 to euc2 and euc1? We have weighted DNS available but need to coordinate TTLs.

oncall-sre: mitigation options: A) shift 50% traffic away from euc3 via weighted Route53, B) increase NLB targetgroup deregistration delay and healthcheck threshold to reduce thrash, C) failover to warm standby (euc1) entirely if situation worsens. Recommend A+B now.

jamie: agree. Changing healthcheck sensitivity first to avoid target churn: set health_interval=30s, unhealthy_threshold=4, deregistration_delay=240s on affected targetgroup. Applying now.

alex: performing weighted DNS shift: pushing 40% to euc2 and 10% to euc1 (leave 50% on euc3) for 20 minutes to observe behavior. Command: `route-shift --region euc3 --to euc2:40 --to euc1:10 --ttl 60`.

net-ops-bot: Route shift executed by alex at 09:22:11 UTC.

support-lead: customer advisory: "We are aware of increased errors in EU-Central (euc3). We are routing a portion of traffic to alternate regions and investigating with our provider. No data loss. Updates every 15 minutes." Sending now.

priya: provider reports partial hardware reboot on a peering switch at 09:10 UTC due to a failed control plane process. They applied a rollback at 09:18 and said sessions are 'recovering'. Asking for time-windowed BGP dumps.

jamie: after healthcheck tuning + route shift we see 5xx drop from 18% -> 5% within 8 minutes. Envoy RSTs down ~70%. Good trend but not fully healed.

oncall-sre: leave shift in place for 30m. If stable, gradually move traffic back. Also log decision: no infra changes to proxy_protocol right now.

alex: capturing tcpdump pre/post. Pre-mitigation snippet shows SYNs followed by RST from provider edge: `10:14:12.123456 IP edge-ip > ingress: Flags [S], seq 0` then `10:14:12.123556 IP ingress > edge-ip: Flags [R]`. Post-mitigation shows clean 3-way handshakes.

support-lead: outreach done to medstream and shopwise contact teams. Both acknowledged and asked for timeline; we've provided the advisory and will update.

priya: provider gave an interim note: root cause likely a control-plane bug triggering intermittent forwarding path drops during a partial reboot. They will perform extended validation and provide an RCA in 72h.

jamie: monitoring shows tail latency for successful requests unchanged. Error responses are concentrated on specific edge IP blocks that map to the problematic peering fabric.

oncall-sre: action items to close this incident: 1) automation - add emergency weighted-shift CLI with pre-approved playbook 2) SRE - create healthcheck profiles tuned for peering flaps 3) Network - integrate provider BGP session monitors into alerting.

net-ops-bot: suppressing related ingress-5xx-euc3-01 alert for 40m per mitigation policy.

jamie: preparing artifacts for postmortem: envoy logs, tcpdumps, Route53 change IDs, targetgroup modification history. Saving to /var/incidents/3142001234/.

support-lead: drafting final customer note: will include timeline and mitigation steps.

priya: provider confirms stable BGP adjacency at 09:30 and no further flaps observed. They will circulate full traces.

oncall-sre: monitoring for 45 more minutes then hand off to next oncall with RCA tasking.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - ingress-euc3 alert cleared at 09:32 UTC. Status: degraded -> stable. Preliminary cause: provider peering/control-plane reboot causing forwarding drops. Provider RCA pending.

alex: closing handoff. Postmortem owner assigned to jamie. Support to complete customer impact spreadsheet and notify account teams.
